chat.title: AppleBot
chat.subtitle: AI-powered · usually replies instantly
chat.greeting: Hi! 👋 I'm AppleBot — ask me about prices, repair times, or how to book. I can also help track a repair.

replies.price: Most repairs start with a free diagnosis — once we know what is needed we send a fixed quote. Type your device + issue (e.g. “iPhone 13 screen”) and I will share a starting price.
replies.screen: Screen replacements use genuine Apple-grade parts. Service usually completes within 24 hours. Want me to start a booking?
replies.battery: Battery service for iPhone, MacBook, iPad and Apple Watch — original cells, 90-day warranty. Free health check on walk-in.
replies.track: You can track any repair with your ticket ID right on the homepage — or paste it here and I will look it up.
replies.warranty: Every repair is covered by our 90-day warranty. No-fix, no-fee — if we cannot fix it, you owe nothing.
replies.hello: Hi! I am AppleBot — ask me about prices, repair times, or how to book. I can also help track a repair.
replies.fallback: Got it. A human engineer can take over any time — tap “Book a Repair” at the top, or share your device + issue here and I will guide you.
